description: Sage is a virtual Mythic agent that that uses an AI agentic system to operate Mythic and Mythic agents running on compromised hosts.

written.description: Installs into a Mythic C2 server and operates it from the inside, reasoning over the live callbacks and the BloodHound graph to issue Mythic tasks. It never touches the target itself.

alive.last_commit_message:
Install Sage from the published release image

mythic-cli install now pulls ghcr.io/mythicagents/sage:0.2.0, named in
config.json's remote_images, instead of building the container locally.
Operators who want a local build set sage_use_build_context to true.

The release version check and the version tests now require that image
reference to match agent_version, so a version bump cannot leave the
installer pointing at an older release.
